title: Rosalind and the Archive
author: Petra Lockridge
blurb: Wendell Montrose, the last human technician on an automated relay station, has spent five years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
